systems.country_label: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)
systems.tiers: not stated; a planning, management and monitoring tool to which school health and well-being indicators (hygiene, nutrition, water access, safety) were being added in August 2025

note: SIGE is described as collecting, analysing and using education data for policy, with health indicators being added; the document does not say who enters data, how often, or whether any record is per learner, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
